title: Graduate Machine Learning Engineer
description: Join our applied machine learning team as a graduate engineer. You will train and evaluate models in PyTorch, prepare data pipelines in Python, and package models with Docker for our internal serving platform. We look for a degree in computer science or a related field, a solid grasp of machine learning basics, and projects that show you can take a model from a notebook to a working service. Mentoring and a structured first year are part of the programme.

title: Junior Data Scientist
description: Our pricing team needs a junior data scientist to build claim frequency models and explain them to actuaries. Day to day you will query policy data with SQL, explore it in Pandas, and fit and validate models in scikit-learn. You will present findings in short written notes. Up to two years of experience, including internships, is fine.

title: AI Engineer, LLM Applications
description: We build assistants for customer service teams on top of large language models. As an AI engineer you will design retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, write prompt and evaluation code in Python, and expose features through FastAPI services. Experience with LangChain or a similar framework, and with vector search, is a strong plus. This role suits a graduate with zero to two years of experience and real projects.

title: Associate NLP Engineer
description: Help us build text classification and entity extraction models for legal documents. You will fine-tune transformer models with Hugging Face Transformers and PyTorch, clean and label training data, and measure model quality. A degree in computing and a natural language processing project are required.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: We need a machine learning engineer with at least three years of experience to own our demand forecasting and dispatch models in production. You will run training jobs on Kubernetes, build MLOps tooling for model monitoring, and work with backend engineers on low-latency serving. Strong PyTorch and production experience required.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: Lead the design of our next forecasting platform. You bring seven or more years of building machine learning systems, have led a team of engineers, and can set technical direction for model training, evaluation, and serving at scale.

title: Lead Data Scientist
description: Head a group of eight data scientists in our credit risk division. You will set the modelling roadmap, review model governance documents, and report to the chief risk officer. Ten or more years of experience and a track record of leading teams are required.

title: Data Analyst
description: Turn sales and inventory data into weekly reports for store managers. You will write SQL queries, build Tableau dashboards, and answer ad hoc questions from the merchandising team. Strong Excel skills and attention to detail are needed; Python is a bonus.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description: Build and maintain the batch pipelines that feed our recommendation models. You will write Spark jobs in Python, schedule them with Airflow, and model tables in SQL. This is a junior role for someone with up to two years of experience who enjoys data quality work.

title: Graduate MLOps Engineer
description: Our platform team is hiring a graduate to automate model training and deployment. You will write Python tooling, maintain CI/CD pipelines, build Docker images, and run workloads on Kubernetes. Interest in machine learning systems is expected; deep modelling skills are not.

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Develop real-time perception for warehouse robots. You will write C++ and CUDA code for detection models, optimise inference with OpenCV and TensorRT, and test on embedded hardware. Two or more years of computer vision experience required.

title: Research Engineer, Machine Learning
description: Work with research scientists to turn new learning methods into reproducible experiments. You will implement papers in PyTorch, run large-scale training, and co-author publications. A master's or PhD with two to four years of research experience is preferred.

title: AI Intern
description: A six-month internship on our assistants team. You will help build evaluation sets for language model features, write Python scripts, and join daily stand-ups. Open to students in their final year.

title: Data Science Graduate Programme
description: A two-year rotation programme for new graduates across fraud, marketing, and credit analytics. Each rotation builds models in Python and SQL with a senior data scientist as your mentor. We look for strong statistics, machine learning coursework, and at least one end-to-end project.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: Build Power BI dashboards for revenue and occupancy, maintain the data model behind them, and train hotel managers to use the reports. You will work mostly in Power BI, DAX, and Excel, with some SQL.

title: Quantitative Researcher
description: Research and test systematic trading signals. You will write C++ and Python, apply time-series statistics, and work closely with traders. A PhD in a quantitative field and two or more years in trading are required.

title: Applied Scientist, Recommendations
description: Improve the ranking models behind our video feed. You will design experiments, build features, and train deep learning recommenders in PyTorch. We expect three to five years of applied machine learning experience and strong statistics.

title: Junior AI Solutions Engineer
description: Help customers build their first generative AI features. You will build demos in Python that call large language model APIs, write small retrieval prototypes, and explain them to client teams. Clear speaking and a portfolio of AI projects matter more than years of experience.

title: Data Annotation Specialist
description: Label images and short texts that train our AI models. You will follow detailed guidelines, maintain labeling quality above our target, and flag unclear cases. No programming is needed; care and consistency are.

title: Email Marketing Executive
description: Plan and send our weekly email campaigns to retail customers. You will maintain the mailing lists, write detailed campaign briefs, test subject lines, and report open and click rates. Experience with an email platform and an eye for detail are required.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description: Run our digital advertising across search and social channels. You will manage budgets, plan campaigns, build audience segments, and report on bookings from each channel.

title: Training Coordinator
description: Organise training for our warehouse and driver teams. You will maintain the training calendar, book rooms and trainers, keep attendance records, and collect feedback after each course.

title: Retail Store Supervisor
description: Supervise a team of six in our flagship store. You will open and close the store, maintain stock displays, coach staff to give good service, and keep things going smoothly on busy weekends.

title: Machine Learning Platform Engineer
description: Build the platform that trains and serves our models. You will write Go services for the feature store, run training jobs on Kubernetes in AWS, and design gRPC interfaces that data scientists call. Three or more years of backend or platform engineering experience required; machine learning knowledge is a plus.

title: Data Scientist, Experimentation
description: Own A/B testing for our product teams. You will design experiments, analyse results in Python and SQL, and coach product managers on statistics. Two to four years of data science experience are required.

title: Graduate Software Engineer, Python
description: Join a product team that builds data tools for editors. You will write Python services, small APIs, and tests, and work with data scientists on the features they need. Any computing graduate with Python projects is welcome.

title: NLP Data Scientist
description: Build models that sort customer messages in English and Chinese. You will clean text data, fine-tune transformer models, and measure accuracy for each language. Zero to two years of experience, Python, and a natural language processing project are required.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description: Design our streaming data platform. You will build Kafka and Spark pipelines, set data modelling standards, and mentor junior engineers. Six or more years of data engineering are required.

title: Statistician
description: Design household surveys and produce official estimates. You will work in R and SAS, write methodology notes, and check the quality of each release. Two or more years in survey statistics are required.

title: Junior ML Engineer, Edge Devices
description: Make our models run on small devices. You will quantise PyTorch models, convert them to TensorFlow Lite, and write C++ code to call them on embedded boards. A graduate with machine learning projects and some C++ is ideal.

title: AI Product Manager
description: Own the roadmap for our AI assistant products. You will talk to customers, write requirements, and prioritise work for three engineering teams. Three or more years of product management are required.

title: Junior Data Scientist, Healthcare
description: Build models that predict hospital readmission and explain them to clinicians. You will use Python, Pandas, scikit-learn, and SQL on anonymised patient records. A degree and machine learning projects are required; healthcare knowledge is a plus.

title: Deep Learning Engineer
description: Scale training of large vision and language models. You will write distributed PyTorch code, profile GPU jobs, and improve training speed. Two or more years of deep learning engineering are required.

title: Analytics Engineer
description: Model our warehouse tables in dbt and SQL so that analysts get clean, tested data. You will write transformations, document models, and add data tests. Up to two years of experience.

title: LLM Evaluation Analyst
description: Check the quality of our language model outputs. You will write test prompts, score answers against guidelines, and script simple checks in Python. A background in linguistics or computing suits this role.

title: Backend Engineer
description: Build the services behind our card issuing product. You will design REST APIs in Java with Spring Boot, model data in PostgreSQL, and own your services in production. Three to five years of backend experience required.

title: Platform Engineer
description: Run the Kubernetes platform that all our product teams deploy to. You will write Go operators, manage AWS infrastructure, and improve the developer experience of our deploy tooling. Two to five years of platform or infrastructure experience.

title: Software Engineer II, Payments
description: Join the payments core team. You will build Java services that process transfers, publish and consume Kafka events, and keep our ledger correct under load. We look for three or more years of building backend systems.

title: Backend Engineer, Go
description: Write the Go services that track our vehicle fleet in real time. You will build gRPC APIs, cache hot data in Redis, and store history in PostgreSQL. Two or more years of Go in production required.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Lead the design of new payment products. You bring six or more years of Java backend experience, mentor engineers, and own system design reviews for your area.

title: Staff Engineer, Platform
description: Set the technical direction for our infrastructure. Ten or more years of experience, deep Kubernetes and networking knowledge, and a record of leading large migrations are required.

title: Junior Backend Developer
description: Start your career on our Java team. You will fix bugs, write tests, and build small features in our Spring Boot services. Zero to two years of experience.

title: Backend Engineer, Python
description: Build the APIs behind our content management system. You will write Python services in Django, model data in PostgreSQL, and work with the frontend team. Three or more years of Django experience required.

title: Frontend Engineer
description: Build the web app that our customers use every day. You will write JavaScript and TypeScript with React, build accessible components, and work closely with designers. Three or more years of frontend experience required.

title: Full-stack JavaScript Developer
description: Build our online store end to end. You will write React on the front and Node.js with Express on the back, and connect both to MongoDB. Two or more years of full-stack JavaScript experience.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Keep our services fast and available. You will run Kubernetes clusters, build Prometheus alerts, write Go tools for incident response, and lead post-incident reviews. Two or more years of SRE or operations experience.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automate our build and release process. You will write Terraform for AWS, maintain CI/CD pipelines, and support teams with Docker. Two to four years of DevOps experience.

title: Data Engineer
description: Build the pipelines that move market data into our research platform. You will write Kafka consumers in Java, run Spark jobs, and model tables for analysts. Two to five years of data engineering.

title: Full-stack Engineer
description: Build the tools that our claims staff use. You will write Java services with Spring Boot and React screens, and own features from database to browser. Three or more years of experience.

title: iOS Developer
description: Build our rider app for iPhone. You will write Swift and SwiftUI, work with our API team, and ship weekly releases. Three or more years of iOS development.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description: Help our customers by chat and email. You need good written English, a calm manner, and a habit of going the extra mile. Experience with Google Workspace and a ticketing tool is a plus.

title: Sales Development Representative
description: Open new conversations with companies that could use our platform. You are goal-oriented, good on the phone, and keep your pipeline up to date. Weekly targets and a clear bonus plan.

title: Backend Engineering Intern
description: A three-month internship on our Java services. You will write tests, fix small bugs, and present a project at the end. Open to students.

title: Principal Software Architect
description: Shape the architecture of our core banking platform. Fifteen or more years of experience, enterprise architecture certification, and a record of leading bank-wide programmes are required.

title: Backend Engineer, Kotlin
description: Build the booking services of our logistics marketplace. You will write Kotlin with Spring Boot, store data in PostgreSQL, and publish Kafka events. Java developers who want to move to Kotlin are welcome.

title: Golang Developer
description: Write the Go microservices that power our streaming apps. You will build REST and gRPC APIs, work with MongoDB and Redis, and run services on Kubernetes. Two or more years of Go.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Run our move to AWS. You will set up networking, accounts, and security controls, and help teams deploy their apps. Two or more years of AWS and Linux administration.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description: Build automated tests for our web and API products. You will write Selenium and REST tests in Java, run them in CI, and report on test coverage. Two or more years of test automation.

title: Integration Engineer
description: Connect our warehouse system to partner carriers. You will build REST integrations in Java, map data formats, and monitor message flows. Two or more years of integration or backend work.

title: Software Engineer, Search Backend
description: Make product search fast and relevant. You will build Java services around Elasticsearch, tune queries, and add caching with Redis. Three or more years of backend experience.

title: Backend Engineer, .NET
description: Build internal banking services in C# and .NET, with SQL Server and REST APIs. Three or more years of .NET backend experience.

title: Graduate Software Engineer
description: Our graduate programme takes engineers in any language. You will rotate through two product teams, mostly writing Java services, and learn our engineering practices. A computing degree and coding projects are needed.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: Lead our Kubernetes platform roadmap. Seven or more years of platform experience, deep Go skills, and experience running multi-region clusters are required.

title: Lead Backend Engineer
description: Lead a team of six backend engineers. Eight or more years of Java experience and two or more years of people management are required.

title: Database Administrator
description: Look after our PostgreSQL and Oracle databases. You will plan backups, tune performance, and manage upgrades. Three or more years of DBA work.

title: Backend Engineer, Remote
description: A fully remote role on our API team. You will build Java services on AWS, design REST APIs, and write clear technical documents. Three or more years of backend experience; any time zone within four hours of Singapore.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description: Write firmware for our robot controllers in C on an RTOS. You will debug hardware, write drivers, and test on the bench. Two or more years of embedded development.

title: API Engineer
description: Own our public API. You will write Go services, keep the OpenAPI specification current, and store data in PostgreSQL. Two or more years of backend experience.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description: Solve technical problems for our enterprise customers. You will read logs on Linux servers, run SQL queries, and write clear answers in our ticketing system.

title: Event Streaming Engineer
description: Build the event streaming backbone of our trading systems. You will write Java services with Kafka and Flink, design event schemas, and tune throughput. Three or more years of backend or streaming experience.
